subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “At first, the town looked less green.”?
options: Ecologists later found that local birds and plants needed open grassland.
Plants, soil, and stones were working together.
The city restored one section with plants, stones, and gentle slopes.
Later, new gardens appeared with stones, local plants, and shaded soil.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Ecologists later found that local birds and plants needed open grassland.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Plants, soil, and stones were working together.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The city restored one section with plants, stones, and gentle slopes.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「At first, the town looked less green. Later, new gardens appeared with stones, local plants, and shaded soil.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
